sentences.text: Aleksandr Grigoryevich Lukashenko -LRB- Алякса́ндр Рыго́равіч Лукашэ́нка , Aliaksandr Ryhoravič Lukašenka , Алекса́ндр Григо́рьевич Лукаше́нко born 30 August 1954 -RRB- is the President of Belarus , in office since 20 July 1994 .	President of Belarus	President of Belarus	Belarus	Belarus	President	President of Belarus

Before his career as a politician , Lukashenko worked as director of a state-owned agricultural farm and spent time with the Soviet Border Troops and the Soviet Army .	Soviet Border Troops	Soviet Border Troops	Soviet Army	Soviet Army
He was the only deputy to vote against the independence of Belarus from the Soviet Union .	Soviet Union	Soviet Union	Belarus	Belarus
Lukashenko opposed Western-backed `` shock therapy '' during the post-Soviet transition .	shock therapy	Shock therapy (economics)
He has retained Soviet-era policies , such as continued state ownership of key industries , despite objections from Western governments .	state ownership	state ownership
Observers also contend that Lukashenko presides over a regime steeped in Soviet nostalgia .	Soviet nostalgia	Nostalgia for the Soviet Union

Belarus has been labeled `` Europe 's last dictatorship '' by some Western journalists , on account of Lukashenko 's self-described authoritarian style of government .	Belarus	Belarus	authoritarian	authoritarian

Lukashenko and other Belarusian officials are also the subject of sanctions imposed by the European Union and the United States for human rights violations off and on since 2006 .	sanctions	International sanctions	human rights violations	human rights violations
